title: 家与家务
goal: 会描述自己的家（几室、在哪、有什么），会说家务和家里的东西坏了需要修。
tips: 美式 apartment，英式 flat，都是公寓；a two-bedroom apartment = 两室的公寓。
家务用 do / take out / clean：do the dishes 洗碗，do the laundry 洗衣服，take out the trash 倒垃圾。
东西坏了：The ... is broken. / The ... doesn't work. / The sink is leaking.（水槽漏水）

exchanges.hear: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
exchanges.hearZh: 你住独栋房子还是公寓？
exchanges.reply: An apartment. It has two bedrooms.

exchanges.hear: Do you rent or own your place?
exchanges.hearZh: 你的房子是租的还是自己的？
exchanges.reply: I rent it. The rent is a bit high.

exchanges.hear: Who does the cooking at home?
exchanges.reply: My husband cooks, and I do the dishes.

exchanges.hear: Can you take out the trash?
What's wrong with the washing machine?
exchanges.reply: It doesn't turn on. I think it's broken.

exchanges.hear: Hi, this is your landlord. Is everything OK with the apartment?
exchanges.hearZh: 你好，我是房东。房子一切都好吗？
exchanges.reply: Mostly, but the kitchen sink is leaking.
exchanges.replyZh: 基本都好，就是厨房水槽漏水。

exchanges.hear: How do you like your new place?
exchanges.reply: I love it. The balcony gets a lot of sun.
exchanges.replyZh: 很喜欢，阳台阳光特别好。

exchanges.hear: Do you get along with your roommate?
exchanges.reply: Yes, but he never cleans the bathroom.
exchanges.replyZh: 挺好的，就是他从来不打扫卫生间。

lines.en: Hi, Mr. Brown. This is Li from apartment three B.
lines.zh: 布朗先生你好，我是 3B 的小李。

lines.en: Oh, hi Li. What can I do for you?
lines.zh: 哦，你好小李。有什么事吗？

lines.en: The fridge isn't working. It's not cold at all.
I'm sorry to hear that. When did it stop working?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。什么时候开始不工作的？

lines.en: Yesterday evening. All my food is going bad.
lines.zh: 昨天晚上。我的食物都要坏了。

lines.en: I'll send someone to fix it. Are you home tomorrow morning?
lines.zh: 我派人去修。你明天上午在家吗？

lines.en: I have to work, but my roommate will be home.
lines.zh: 我要上班，不过我室友在家。

lines.en: Great. The repairman will come around ten.
lines.zh: 好的，维修工大概十点到。

lines.en: Thank you. I'll let her know.
